# Kirill Ateev Art — kirillateev.art

> Personal website of artist Kirill Ateev, who works in the style of kinetic minimalism (Kinimalism). All works are animated SVG images issued as NFTs on the Ethereum blockchain; images and metadata are stored on-chain. The site is static and has English (/en), Russian (/ru), Chinese (/zh), Hindi (/hi) and Spanish (/es) versions.

The website is completely static. English links are used below; replace `/en` with `/ru`, `/zh`, `/hi` or `/es` for the corresponding language version. Each collection contains unique animated SVG images. Individual works can be viewed on collection pages using routes like `/en/view/blinds/321`.

Technical notes for LLMs:
- All NFT images are SVG files. Each image is placed in an `<img>` tag with an `alt` attribute containing the work’s title and the artist’s name.
- Structured data using JSON-LD Schema.org `VisualArtwork` with full metadata is present on individual work pages or collection cards.
- External links on collection pages lead to Rarible collection profiles.

## Main Pages

- [Home Page](https://kirillateev.art/en): Brief welcome and links to the latest collections.
- [Messages / Blog](https://kirillateev.art/en/messages): Blog and news.
- [Article about Kinimalism](https://kirillateev.art/en/messages/kinimalism): Explanation of Kinimalism.
- [Community](https://kirillateev.art/en/community): Community section on the website.
